title: Research contract v0.2: canonical reference layout + bounded framing
objective: Normalize the canonical badf-research reference surface and make assumptions, decision_context and non-empty stop_conditions first-class in the research record without introducing a second router, validator, council or authority plane.
business_value: A governed research capability must be able to prove not only what it investigated but why collection was bounded and why it stopped. A single canonical reference layout reduces drift before the remaining subskills are distributed.
in_scope: skills/badf-research/SKILL.md and canonical seven-file reference surface
all shipped research examples + template aligned to the schema
badf-research registry version/digest re-pin; integrity lockfile re-sign
reconcile landed WP-2026-0040 before admitting WP-2026-0041
out_of_scope: control 6 live source-digest staleness / source acquisition
new research router, validator, council, memory store or authority mechanism
root badf-research activation; status remains DESIGNED
acceptance_criteria: the root skill names exactly the canonical seven research references and remains DESIGNED/no authority
research types, depths, states, dispositions, source/claim/confidence vocabularies match schema enums
schema requires assumptions and decision_context and at least one stop_condition
all three shipped research examples satisfy the schema and preserve their existing evidence_digest
legacy lifecycle.md, routing-and-authority.md and acceptance.md are removed so no duplicate normative research contracts remain
badf-research registry entry is version 0.2.0, DESIGNED, allowed_tools empty and digest equals sha256(SKILL.md)
repo integrity is re-signed and canonical BADF checks/CI pass on the composed tree

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; restore v0.1 reference filenames and schema fields from 8896a37

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design and requires independent G07 review before merge. Root badf-research remains DESIGNED; this work changes contract structure, not operational authority.
